events.credibility_reason: Attribution of index 852770 to Kynea rather than Carol is unresolved; primary source (Prime-Wiki) not opened.
Known only from a search snippet; page not opened.
Content unknown; thesis not opened, only an OEIS citation.

why: The statement asks only whether infinitely many Kynea primes exist. Individual prime finds (2016, 2019) are finitely many instances and settle nothing; the 2024 base-10 find concerns (10^n+1)^2-2, a different family under the standard base-2 definition, so it is a variant (and even under the Prime-Wiki base-b reading it would only be an instance). Sparavigna's groupoid paper and the unread Hibbs thesis bear on the topic without settling or bounding anything. No AI involvement was found in any event.
doubts: Prime-Wiki pages were unreachable, so post-2019 base-2 finds (if any) could not be checked; any such find would still be an instance only. The Hibbs thesis content is unknown.
